items.the_assumption_to_attack: my plan's load-bearing assumption is hyp:agent-officers-cut-cost: that agent officers working through a licensed partner cut the cost to serve a 25 USDC loan far enough below an MFI's 19% to 28% operating ratio that 9% to 18% APR plus a sponsored first-loss reserve covers 3% to 6% losses a cycle. If the partner's own cost (KYC, collection, cash handling, ramps) dominates, the product is a subsidy and must be called one. Attack it with numbers: what a licensed partner in the Philippines or Kenya actually charges per loan serviced, what a mobile-money round trip of 25 USDC costs all-in, and what first-cycle default a group-backed cohort shows in published data.
